plugins.name: implement-orchestrated
plugins.description: Orchestrator-subagent /implement built on Matt Pocock's skills: parallel coders in worktrees, per-ticket review, fixes sent back to the same coder.

plugins.name: naming-ja
plugins.description: Name an app or product for Japan with its owner: taste first, a wide list across Japanese naming styles, owner-made cuts, and App Store Japan, trademark, domain and meaning checks.

plugins.name: break-reminder
plugins.description: Pomodoro-style break reminders on macOS: a sound and a dialog after 25 minutes of keyboard and mouse activity, a notification when the 5-minute break ends, and time away from the desk restarts the clock.

plugins.name: small-start
plugins.description: Run a hard-to-start day from one Claude Code session: a slide deck kept current at one URL, one small next step with a default answer, work handed to the session or agent that owns it, results checked with screenshots, and deploys waited on in the background.
